#=============================================================================
#
# file :        CMakeLists.txt
#
# description : File to generate a TANGO device server using cmake.
#
# project :     TemperatureSensor
#
#=============================================================================
#                This file is generated by POGO
#        (Program Obviously used to Generate tango Object)
#
#  MODIFIED: Debian's libtango-dev ships pkg-config files (tango.pc), not
#  Pogo's classic cmake_tango.opt/cmake_common_target.opt convention -- those
#  two include()s are replaced below with pkg-config equivalents.
#=============================================================================
#
#
cmake_minimum_required (VERSION 3.18...3.26 FATAL_ERROR)
set(CMAKE_SKIP_RPATH TRUE)
#
# Project definitions
#
project(TemperatureSensor CXX)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 17)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON)
#
# optional compiler flags
#
set(CXXFLAGS_USER -g)
#
# Get global information (via pkg-config instead of Pogo's cmake_tango.opt)
#
find_package(PkgConfig REQUIRED)
pkg_check_modules(TANGO REQUIRED tango)
find_package(Threads REQUIRED)
set(TANGO_INCLUDES ${TANGO_INCLUDE_DIRS})
#
# Files for TemperatureSensor TANGO class
#
set(TEMPERATURESENSOR TemperatureSensor)
set(TEMPERATURESENSOR_INCLUDE ${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR})
set(TEMPERATURESENSOR_SRC  ${TEMPERATURESENSOR}.cpp
                           ${TEMPERATURESENSOR}Class.cpp
                           ${TEMPERATURESENSOR}StateMachine.cpp)
#
# User additional include, link folders/libraries and source files
#
set(USER_INCL_DIR )
set(USER_LIB_DIR )
set(USER_LIBS )
set(USER_SRC_FILES )
#
# Set global info and include directories
#
set(ALL_CLASS_INCLUDE  ${TEMPERATURESENSOR_INCLUDE}  ${USER_INCL_DIR})
set(SERVER_SRC ${TEMPERATURESENSOR_SRC}  ${USER_SRC_FILES} ClassFactory.cpp main.cpp)
include_directories(${ALL_CLASS_INCLUDE}  ${USER_INCL_DIR} ${TANGO_INCLUDES})
#
# Device Server generation (via pkg-config instead of Pogo's cmake_common_target.opt)
#
set(SERVER_NAME TemperatureSensor)
add_executable(${SERVER_NAME} ${SERVER_SRC})
target_link_directories(${SERVER_NAME} PRIVATE ${TANGO_LIBRARY_DIRS} ${USER_LIB_DIR})
target_link_libraries(${SERVER_NAME} PRIVATE ${TANGO_LIBRARIES} ${USER_LIBS} Threads::Threads)
